generic.Defined scope/population: All registered facultative submissions awaiting assignment to a specialist facultative underwriter.
generic.In-scope period: Submissions registered in the current business day, plus expedited risks inside five days to inception.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Assigned underwriter name, assignment date, requested limit, class, and referral flag on the submission header.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Assignments made plus submissions still unassigned equals the day's registered submission count.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Assignment entry and work-queue notification retained in the reinsurance administration system with timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Submissions assigned above the assignee's authority are logged with a mandatory referral flag and disposition.
generic.Test population: All facultative submissions assigned in the reporting month in the reinsurance administration system.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: 100 percent of assigned submissions name an underwriter and carry an assignment date.
generic.Exception handling path: Assignments beyond assignee authority route back to the Reinsurance Manager for reassignment or referral flagging.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Assignee authority covers the requested limit and class, or a mandatory referral flag is set.
generic.Evidence location: Submission header and work queue records in the reinsurance administration system.

steps.title: Open the unassigned facultative submission queue in the reinsurance administration system
sop: Filter the submission queue to status registered with no assigned underwriter
Sort the queue by days to inception so the tightest deadlines surface first
Note requested limit, class, and territory for each queued submission
Done when the unassigned queue is listed in inception-date order
verify: Check the queue count against the day's registered submission count
Pass when every registered unassigned submission appears in the working queue

steps.title: Match requested limit and class to underwriter authority in the underwriting workstation
sop: Open the facultative authority matrix held in the underwriting workstation
Read the per-underwriter limit, class, and territory authority for each candidate assignee
Shortlist the underwriters whose authority covers the requested line and class
Done when a shortlist of authorised assignees exists for the submission
verify: Compare the requested line against each shortlisted underwriter's authority limit
Pass when no shortlisted underwriter has an authority limit below the requested line

steps.title: Check assignee workload and inception dates in the underwriting workstation
sop: Pull the open submission count and nearest inception date for each shortlisted underwriter
Discount any underwriter already carrying an expedited risk incepting inside two business days
Report the workload position back to the Reinsurance Manager
Done when a workload position is available for every shortlisted underwriter
verify: Recount open submissions for the proposed assignee from the queue extract
Pass when the proposed assignee has capacity to quote by the target quote date

steps.title: Set the mandatory referral flag on over-authority submissions in the administration system
sop: Compare the requested line to the chosen assignee's authority limit
Where the line exceeds that limit set the mandatory referral flag on the submission
Record the trigger reason of line size, class, or territory against the flag
Done when every over-authority submission carries a referral flag with a reason
verify: List assigned submissions where the requested line exceeds assignee authority
Pass when every listed submission carries a mandatory referral flag

steps.title: Record the assigned underwriter and assignment date on the submission header
sop: Key the assigned underwriter name onto the submission header in the administration system
Key the assignment date and the target quote date onto the same header
Save the record so the assignment timestamp is captured by the system
Done when the submission header shows assignee name and assignment date
verify: Re-open the submission header and read the assignee and assignment date fields
Pass when both fields are populated and the assignee matches the authorised shortlist

steps.title: Notify the assignee through the underwriting workstation work queue
sop: Confirm the assignment notification has landed in the work queue with the target quote date
Acknowledge the assignment so the queue records receipt
Raise any authority or capacity concern back to the Reinsurance Manager the same day
Done when the assignee has acknowledged the queued submission
verify: Check the work queue for an acknowledgement entry against the submission
Pass when the assignee acknowledgement is recorded with the target quote date visible

generic.Defined scope/population: All registered facultative submissions requiring clearance against existing cessions and in-force cover.
generic.In-scope period: Submissions registered since the last clearance run, before any move to triage status.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Clearance outcome, existing certificate number, and aggregate line already committed on the submission record.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of submissions cleared equals the count of submissions moved to triage in the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Clearance search results and outcome entry retained against the submission with a search timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Submissions already on risk are logged as partial line held or already on risk with the certificate reference.
generic.Test population: All facultative submissions reaching triage status in the reporting month.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: 100 percent of triaged submissions carry a populated clearance outcome field.
generic.Exception handling path: Duplicate or already-covered risks route to the Facultative Reinsurance Specialist for a line decision.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Clearance outcome recorded as clear, already on risk, or partial line held before triage.
generic.Evidence location: Submission clearance fields in the reinsurance administration system and the treaty repository search log.

steps.title: Search existing cessions on the insured and location in the administration system
sop: Search the cession master on original insured name and location address
Widen the search on alternate insured spellings and parent company names
List every matching in-force or recently expired cession
Done when the cession search results are captured against the submission
verify: Repeat the search on the insured's registered address to confirm no match is missed
Pass when the captured result set covers both name and address searches

steps.title: Check in-force treaty cover for the risk in the treaty repository
sop: Open the in-force treaty programme covering the class and territory of the risk
Check whether the risk falls inside treaty scope rather than needing facultative cover
Note the treaty reference and capacity available for the exposure
Done when the treaty position for the risk is documented
verify: Cross-check the treaty reference against the treaty repository in-force list
Pass when the cited treaty is in force for the submission inception date

steps.title: Check the underlying policy in the policy administration system
sop: Look up the original insured and policy number in the policy administration system
Confirm whether the company already writes the underlying policy or another layer
Record the policy number and layer position found
Done when the underlying policy position is recorded on the submission
verify: Compare the policy inception and limit found to the slip presentation
Pass when the policy position recorded matches the policy administration system record

steps.title: Confirm the company is not already on the risk through another broker
sop: Compare inception date, layer, and share across all matching submissions and cessions
Identify any line already committed on the same layer via a different intermediary
Total the aggregate line already committed on the risk
Done when the committed aggregate line on the risk is quantified
verify: Re-add the committed lines from the matched cession list
Pass when the recorded aggregate line equals the sum of matched committed lines

steps.title: Record the clearance outcome on the submission record
sop: Set the clearance outcome to clear, already on risk, or partial line held
Where a line is held key the existing certificate number and committed line
Save the clearance search date against the submission
Done when the clearance outcome and supporting references are saved
verify: Re-open the submission and read the clearance outcome and certificate reference fields
Pass when the outcome is populated and any held line carries a certificate number

steps.title: Refer held-line submissions to the underwriter before triage
sop: Review submissions cleared as already on risk or partial line held
Decide whether additional line can be offered within per-insured aggregate limits
Record the line decision on the submission before it moves to triage
Done when every held-line submission carries an underwriter line decision
verify: List triaged submissions with a held line and no recorded line decision
Pass when that list is empty for the period

generic.Defined scope/population: Facultative submissions where the driving treaty exclusion and required coverage must be confirmed.
generic.In-scope period: Submissions in triage for the current in-force treaty year.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Treaty article or exclusion reference, facultative amount required, perils, limits, and deductibles sought.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Facultative amount required equals original limit less net retention and treaty capacity.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Treaty wording extract and coverage confirmation retained against the submission with wording version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Submissions with no identifiable treaty driver are logged and referred to the Reinsurance Manager.
generic.Test population: All facultative submissions triaged in the reporting month.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: 100 percent of triaged submissions cite a treaty article or exclusion reference.
generic.Exception handling path: Ambiguous exclusion wording escalates to the Reinsurance Manager for a coverage interpretation.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Coverage sought mirrors the original policy perils, limits, and deductibles with no gap.
generic.Evidence location: Submission record in the reinsurance administration system and the wording extract in the treaty repository.

steps.title: Open the in-force treaty wording in the treaty repository
sop: Select the treaty programme covering the class, territory, and period of the risk
Open the executed wording version rather than a draft or slip summary
Note the wording version and effective dates
Done when the correct in-force treaty wording version is open
verify: Compare the wording effective dates to the submission inception date
Pass when the opened wording is in force at the submission inception date

steps.title: Identify the clause excluding the risk from treaty cover
sop: Read the exclusions and limits articles against the occupancy, territory, and limit of the risk
Identify the specific article that removes the risk from treaty protection
Copy the article number and clause text into the submission notes
Done when the driving article number and text are captured
verify: Re-read the cited article against the risk characteristics
Pass when the cited article demonstrably excludes this risk from the treaty

steps.title: Classify the facultative driver on the submission record
sop: Classify the driver as occupancy exclusion, limit above treaty capacity, or territorial exclusion
Where more than one driver applies record the primary driver first
Save the classification on the submission record
Done when the facultative driver classification is saved
verify: Check the classification against the cited treaty article
Pass when the classification and the cited article describe the same restriction

steps.title: Quantify the amount above net retention and treaty capacity
sop: Read the original policy limit from the policy administration system
Deduct the per-risk net retention and the available treaty capacity for the class
Record the resulting facultative amount required on the submission
Done when the facultative amount required is recorded
verify: Recompute original limit less net retention less treaty capacity
Pass when the recomputed amount equals the recorded facultative amount required

steps.title: Confirm coverage sought mirrors the original policy
sop: Compare perils, limits, sublimits, and deductibles on the slip to the underlying policy wording
Identify any element of the original cover not requested facultatively
Record any coverage gap or difference on the submission record
Done when the coverage comparison and any gap are recorded
verify: Re-check each peril and deductible on the slip against the policy schedule
Pass when every difference between slip and policy is recorded as a gap note

steps.title: Refer unclear exclusion interpretations to the Reinsurance Manager
sop: Review submissions where the treaty driver is ambiguous or contested
Give a written coverage interpretation on the submission record
Record the interpretation date and the article relied on
Done when every ambiguous submission carries a written interpretation
verify: List triaged submissions with no treaty article reference recorded
Pass when that list is empty for the period

generic.Defined scope/population: All open facultative submissions checked against open and prior-year submissions for duplication.
generic.In-scope period: Open submissions plus prior-year submissions for the same inception cycle.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Duplicate flag, closure reason, and cross-reference to the surviving submission reference number.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Open submissions after de-duplication equals distinct insured, inception date, and layer combinations.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Duplicate search extract and closure entry retained against both submission records with a timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Same risk offered by a second broker is linked, with the first-received record kept as primary.
generic.Test population: All open facultative submissions at the reporting date.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero open duplicate pairs on the same insured, inception date, and layer.
generic.Exception handling path: Contested duplicates route to the Facultative Reinsurance Specialist to choose the surviving record.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Each duplicate is closed with reason duplicate and a cross-reference to the surviving record.
generic.Evidence location: Submission records and closure reason fields in the reinsurance administration system.

steps.title: Extract open and prior-year submissions from the administration system
sop: Extract open submissions plus the prior inception year to Microsoft Excel
Include insured name, address, inception date, limit, attachment, and share sought
Standardise insured name and address casing before matching
Done when the standardised submission extract is prepared
verify: Compare the extract row count to the open submission count in the system
Pass when the extract row count equals the system open submission count

steps.title: Match candidate duplicates on insured, address, and inception date in Excel
sop: Build a match key from insured name, postcode, and inception date
List every key appearing more than once as a candidate duplicate pair
Include near matches on insured name for manual review
Done when the candidate duplicate list is produced
verify: Spot-check ten near matches that the rule excluded
Pass when no excluded near match is in fact the same risk and inception

steps.title: Compare slips for identical limit, attachment, and share sought
sop: Open both slips for each candidate pair from the submission records
Compare limit, attachment point, and share sought line by line
Confirm the pair is the same risk and layer rather than a different layer of the same tower
Done when each candidate pair is confirmed as duplicate or distinct
verify: Re-read the attachment point on both slips for each confirmed duplicate
Pass when confirmed duplicates share identical limit, attachment, and share

steps.title: Link second-broker offerings and keep the first-received as primary
sop: Compare the receipt timestamps on the two submission records
Keep the earliest received submission as the primary record
Link the later record to the primary with a cross-reference
Done when each duplicate pair has a designated primary record
verify: Check the receipt timestamps on both records of each pair
Pass when the retained primary is the earlier received record

steps.title: Close the duplicate submission with reason duplicate
sop: Set the duplicate record status to closed with reason duplicate
Key the surviving submission reference number as the cross-reference
Save the closure date on the duplicate record
Done when the duplicate is closed with a cross-reference recorded
verify: List submissions closed as duplicate with no cross-reference populated
Pass when that list is empty for the period

steps.title: Notify the second broker that the risk is already under review
sop: Tell the second broker the risk is already under review from another source
Avoid disclosing the identity of the first-presenting intermediary
File the notification against the closed duplicate submission
Done when the notification is filed against the duplicate record
verify: Check the closed duplicate record for a filed notification
Pass when every second-broker duplicate carries a filed notification

generic.Defined scope/population: Facultative submissions triaged as outside appetite and to be declined.
generic.In-scope period: Submissions declined in the current reporting month.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Declination reason code, written rationale, declination date, and submission status of declined.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Declined submission count in the pipeline equals declined records held in the document repository.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Declination rationale and slip retained in the document repository with the declination date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Submissions where terms were previously indicated are logged and escalated before declining.
generic.Test population: All facultative submissions with status declined in the reporting month.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero declined submissions without a reason code and a written rationale.
generic.Exception handling path: Declines following an earlier indication of terms route to the Reinsurance Manager before issue.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Rationale references the appetite clause breached and no prior binding indication exists.
generic.Evidence location: Underwriting file in the document management repository and the submission record in the administration system.

steps.title: Confirm the triage outcome supports declination in the underwriting workstation
sop: Re-read the triage outcome and the appetite clause the risk breaches
Confirm no further information would move the risk into appetite
Confirm the decline is a decision rather than an unresolved information gap
Done when declination is confirmed as the correct outcome
verify: Check the triage outcome field against the declination intent
Pass when the triage outcome is refer or decline rather than in appetite

steps.title: Select the declination reason code on the submission record
sop: Select one of appetite, pricing, capacity, loss record, sanctions, or information
Choose the primary driver where several reasons apply
Save the reason code on the submission record
Done when a single primary reason code is saved
verify: Re-open the submission and read the reason code field
Pass when the reason code is populated from the approved code list

steps.title: Write the declination rationale into the underwriting file
sop: Write a one-paragraph rationale naming the appetite clause breached
State the risk feature that breaches the clause in factual terms
Save the rationale to the underwriting file in the document repository
Done when the dated rationale is saved to the underwriting file
verify: Read the filed rationale for a named appetite clause
Pass when the rationale cites the specific appetite clause breached

steps.title: Confirm no prior indication of terms was given on the submission
sop: Search the submission correspondence for any written or verbal indication of terms
Check the pipeline history for a quoted status on the submission
Record the result of the check on the submission record
Done when the no-prior-indication check is recorded
verify: Check the pipeline status history for any quoted entry
Pass when no quoted status precedes the declination, or an escalation is recorded

steps.title: Set the submission status to declined with the declination date
sop: Set the submission status to declined in the administration system
Key the declination date onto the record
Confirm the pipeline entry reflects the declined status
Done when the submission shows declined with a declination date
verify: Re-open the submission and read status and declination date
Pass when status is declined and the declination date is populated

steps.title: Retain the declined submission and slip in the document repository
sop: File the slip, rationale, and reason code entry as one declined-submission set
Index the set by insured name and inception year for future clearance
Confirm the set is retrievable for hit-ratio analysis
Done when the declined submission set is filed and indexed
verify: Search the repository by insured name for the declined set
Pass when the declined slip and rationale are retrievable by insured and year

steps.title: Review declined submissions for appetite consistency
sop: Sample declined submissions for the month from the administration system
Check reason codes are used consistently against the documented appetite
Raise any misapplied reason code back to the declining underwriter
Done when the monthly declination sample review is complete
verify: Recheck the sampled rationales against the appetite statement
Pass when every sampled decline cites an appetite clause that genuinely applies

generic.Defined scope/population: All registered facultative submissions to be logged in the underwriting pipeline.
generic.In-scope period: Submissions received in the current business week with live target quote dates.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Pipeline status, target indication date, target firm quote date, estimated premium, and requested line.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Pipeline entry count equals registered submission count for the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Daily pipeline extract retained with the extract date in the BI reporting platform.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Submissions past their target quote date are logged with a documented delay reason.
generic.Test population: All pipeline entries with status under review during the reporting month.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: 100 percent of pipeline entries carry target indication and firm quote dates.
generic.Exception handling path: Overdue entries escalate to the Reinsurance Manager for a quote-date reset or closure.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Indication date is 48 hours and firm quote date is five business days from receipt.
generic.Evidence location: Underwriting pipeline in the reinsurance administration system and the daily BI extract.

steps.title: Create the pipeline entry in the reinsurance administration system
sop: Open the registered submission and add it to the underwriting pipeline
Set the pipeline status to under review
Link the pipeline entry to the submission reference number
Done when a pipeline entry exists linked to the submission
verify: Search the pipeline for the submission reference
Pass when exactly one pipeline entry exists for the submission

steps.title: Set target indication and firm quote dates on the pipeline entry
sop: Set the target indication date at 48 hours from receipt
Set the target firm quote date at five business days from receipt
Adjust for non-working days so both dates fall on business days
Done when both target dates are saved on the entry
verify: Recompute both target dates from the recorded receipt timestamp
Pass when recorded dates equal the recomputed 48-hour and five-day targets

steps.title: Record estimated premium and requested line for pipeline value
sop: Read estimated premium and requested line from the broker slip
Key both values onto the pipeline entry in the submission currency
Record the currency and any conversion rate applied
Done when premium, line, and currency are recorded on the entry
verify: Compare the keyed premium and line to the slip values
Pass when keyed premium and line equal the slip figures

steps.title: Confirm the entry appears on the daily pipeline extract
sop: Open the daily pipeline extract in the BI reporting platform
Filter to the assigned underwriter and locate the new entry
Report any entry missing from the extract to the Reinsurance Manager
Done when the entry is visible on the assigned underwriter's extract
verify: Compare extract row count to pipeline entry count for the day
Pass when the two counts agree for the reporting day

steps.title: Update pipeline status at each stage change
sop: Move the entry to quoted, ordered, bound, declined, or lapsed as the stage changes
Record the date of each status change on the entry
Update quoted premium when the quote is issued
Done when the pipeline status matches the real submission stage
verify: Compare pipeline status to the submission record status
Pass when pipeline status equals submission status for every open entry

steps.title: Review overdue under-review entries in Microsoft Excel
sop: Export entries still under review past their target quote date
Obtain a documented reason for each overdue entry from the assigned underwriter
Record the reason and a revised target date on the entry
Done when every overdue entry has a reason and revised target
verify: List entries past target quote date with no recorded reason
Pass when that list is empty at the reporting date

generic.Defined scope/population: All facultative submissions declined and requiring a declination notice to the placing broker.
generic.In-scope period: Declinations decided in the last 24 hours and any notice still outstanding.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Submission reference, insured name, inception date, notice send timestamp, and pipeline status of declined.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Declination notices sent equals declination decisions recorded in the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Sent declination notice filed against the submission with its send timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Notices issued beyond 24 hours are logged with the delay reason and disposition.
generic.Test population: All submissions declined in the reporting month.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: 100 percent of declinations have a filed notice sent within 24 hours of the decision.
generic.Exception handling path: Late or undeliverable notices route to the Facultative Reinsurance Specialist for broker follow-up.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Notice quotes submission reference, insured, and inception date without disclosing pricing or capacity.
generic.Evidence location: Submission correspondence file in the reinsurance administration system and the sent email record.

steps.title: Pull the declination decision detail from the administration system
sop: Open the declined submission and read the decision date and reason code
Read submission reference, insured name, and inception date for the notice
Identify the placing broker contact of record
Done when the notice detail and broker contact are gathered
verify: Compare the decision date to the current time
Pass when the notice is being prepared inside the 24-hour window

steps.title: Draft the declination notice in Microsoft Teams or Email
sop: Quote submission reference, insured name, and inception date in the notice
State the declination plainly without internal pricing or capacity detail
Thank the broker for the offer and invite future submissions
Done when the draft notice is complete and free of internal detail
verify: Re-read the draft for any pricing, capacity, or accumulation detail
Pass when the draft discloses no internal pricing or capacity information

steps.title: Review the notice wording before issue
sop: Check the notice does not imply terms were or could be offered
Check the insured name and inception date match the submission record
Approve the notice for issue or return it for amendment
Done when the notice is approved for issue
verify: Compare insured and inception date on the notice to the submission header
Pass when both match the submission header exactly

steps.title: Issue the declination notice to the placing broker
sop: Send the notice to the broker contact of record within 24 hours of the decision
Post the declination to the placement on the reinsurer exchange where the risk arrived there
Capture the send timestamp and any delivery receipt
Done when the notice is sent and the timestamp captured
verify: Compare the send timestamp to the recorded decision timestamp
Pass when the gap between decision and send is 24 hours or less

steps.title: File the sent notice against the submission record
sop: Attach the sent notice to the submission correspondence file
Record the recipient name and send timestamp on the submission
Attach the exchange delivery receipt where one exists
Done when the notice and its timestamp are filed on the submission
verify: Open the submission correspondence file and locate the notice
Pass when the filed notice carries a recipient and send timestamp

steps.title: Confirm the pipeline status is updated to declined
sop: Open the pipeline entry for the submission in the administration system
Confirm the status reads declined with the decision date
Correct any entry still showing under review
Done when the pipeline shows declined for the notified submission
verify: List submissions with a sent declination notice still at under review
Pass when that list is empty for the period

generic.Defined scope/population: All inbound facultative submissions received by email, broker, or reinsurer exchange for registration.
generic.In-scope period: Submissions received during the current business day.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Submission reference, cedant, broker, original insured, inception date, limit, attachment, and share sought.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Registered submission count equals inbound submissions received across all channels for the day.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Slip, statement of values, and loss record attached to the submission with receipt timestamps.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Submissions missing slip or key header data are logged as incomplete with a chase disposition.
generic.Test population: All facultative submissions registered in the reporting month.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: 100 percent of registrations have a unique reference and a broker acknowledgement within 4 hours.
generic.Exception handling path: Unidentifiable or misdirected submissions route to the Reinsurance Ops Manager for allocation.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Header fields match the broker slip and the acknowledgement quotes the submission reference.
generic.Evidence location: Submission record in the reinsurance administration system and attachments in the document repository.

steps.title: Collect inbound submissions from the reinsurer exchange and email
sop: Check the reinsurer exchange placement inbox for new facultative offers
Check the shared facultative mailbox for broker submissions
List every inbound item with its receipt timestamp and source
Done when all inbound submissions for the day are listed
verify: Compare the listed count to items in the exchange and mailbox
Pass when every inbound item appears on the day's list

steps.title: Create the submission record in the administration system
sop: Create a new facultative submission record for each inbound offer
Capture the system-generated submission reference number
Record the receipt timestamp and inbound channel
Done when each inbound offer has a submission reference
verify: Check the reference numbers generated for the day for duplicates
Pass when every submission carries a unique system reference

steps.title: Key cedant, broker, insured, and inception onto the submission header
sop: Read cedant name, broker or intermediary, and original insured from the slip
Key those values with the inception date onto the submission header
Use the legal entity name for cedant and reinsured rather than a trading name
Done when the submission header identification fields are keyed
verify: Compare the keyed header fields to the broker slip
Pass when cedant, broker, insured, and inception match the slip

steps.title: Key requested coverage, limit, attachment, and share from the slip
sop: Read requested coverage, limit, attachment point, and share sought from the slip
Key each value in the slip currency onto the submission record
Record the cession basis stated on the slip
Done when the requested structure fields are keyed
verify: Compare keyed limit, attachment, and share to the slip presentation
Pass when all three keyed values equal the slip values

steps.title: Attach slip, statement of values, and loss record to the document repository
sop: Upload the broker slip, statement of values, and loss record against the submission
Name each document with the submission reference and document type
Note any of the three documents not supplied
Done when supplied documents are attached and gaps noted
verify: Open the submission attachment list in the document repository
Pass when every supplied document is attached and each gap is noted

steps.title: Send the broker acknowledgement quoting the submission reference
sop: Send an acknowledgement to the broker within 4 hours of receipt
Quote the submission reference, insured name, and inception date
File the acknowledgement against the submission with its send timestamp
Done when the acknowledgement is sent and filed
verify: Compare the acknowledgement send timestamp to the receipt timestamp
Pass when the acknowledgement was sent within 4 hours of receipt

steps.title: Review daily registration completeness
sop: Compare the registered submission list to the inbound channel logs
Investigate any inbound item with no submission record
Allocate misdirected or unidentifiable submissions to the right team
Done when every inbound item is registered or dispositioned
verify: Recount inbound items against registered submissions for the day
Pass when the two counts agree or every difference is dispositioned

generic.Defined scope/population: Facultative submissions flagged incomplete and requiring additional underwriting information.
generic.In-scope period: Submissions at pending information status during the current reporting month.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Pending information flag, response due date, outstanding item list, and chase log entries.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Outstanding item count on the record equals items listed in the information request.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Information request and broker responses filed against the submission with send and receipt timestamps.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Requests unanswered past the due date are logged as chases with an escalation disposition.
generic.Test population: All submissions at pending information status during the reporting month.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: 100 percent of pending-information submissions carry a due date and a filed request.
generic.Exception handling path: Repeatedly unanswered requests escalate to the Facultative Reinsurance Specialist to decline or lapse.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: One consolidated request lists every outstanding item rather than piecemeal chases.
generic.Evidence location: Submission correspondence in the administration system and documents in the repository.

steps.title: List every outstanding item from the completeness check
sop: Open the completeness flag and missing item list on the submission
Confirm each listed item is genuinely absent rather than filed under another name
Consolidate the confirmed gaps into a single outstanding item list
Done when a single consolidated outstanding item list exists
verify: Re-check the document repository for each listed missing item
Pass when no listed item is already attached to the submission

steps.title: Confirm the information need with the underwriter
sop: Review the outstanding list against what is actually needed to price the risk
Remove items that will not change the pricing or coverage decision
Add any underwriting item the completeness check did not capture
Done when the underwriter has confirmed the final request list
verify: Compare the confirmed list to the pricing inputs required
Pass when every listed item is needed to price or assess the risk

steps.title: Draft the consolidated information request
sop: Draft one request listing every outstanding item with the reason it is needed
State the response due date and the effect of non-response on the quote date
Address the request to the placing broker and copy the cedant contact of record
Done when the consolidated request is drafted and addressed
verify: Count the items on the draft against the confirmed outstanding list
Pass when the draft lists every confirmed outstanding item once

steps.title: Set the submission to pending information with a due date
sop: Set the submission status to pending information
Key the response due date onto the submission record
Record the outstanding item list on the record
Done when status, due date, and item list are saved
verify: Re-open the submission and read status and due date
Pass when status is pending information and the due date is populated

steps.title: Send the request and diarise the chase
sop: Send the request to the broker and copy the cedant contact
Diarise a chase for the response due date
Log each chase against the submission with its date
Done when the request is sent and a chase is diarised
